# Preface {.unnumbered}

Regression test for #14879: `back-to-top-navigation` set under the `book`
key must control the book website output, not just `website:`. This page
is tall enough to scroll and exercise the show/hide/click-to-top behavior
of the `#quarto-back-to-top` control.
